answer: Participants then wander across epochs, and reputation accrues only along a single continuous thread of attested history; any node that forks identities loses that thread and starts at zero weight. Each agent must stake a bonded identity anchored to a verifiable hardware atlas of device fingerprints, so spinning up thousands of fake personas requires buying and maintaining real distinct hardware, making the cost scale linearly with identity count. Attacker cost: hardware procurement plus forfeited stake on every detected clone. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
